## Research pass: the kind table (2026-11-22)

Source: `main` at the time of this pass. No build and no test run.

### What `main` has today

- The runtime fields are `Approach::start_point` and `Approach::exit_point` (`crates/motion/src/approach.rs:162,168`), model XY in mm. They live in `links.approach`. Only kinds with a `links` field can hold them.
- The project file key is `links.approach.start_point` / `exit_point` (`crates/app/src/project/approach.rs:77,81`). The digest bytes are `0xC7` / `0xC8`.
- The command is `EditOperationParams`. The MCP door is the generic patch of `edit_operation`. Its schema does not name the two fields.
- The UI rows (`start_exit_rows.rs`) and the viewport pick (`start_exit_pick.rs`) show only on the 2D Contour Lead in / Lead out tab.
- `sane.rs:71-87` refuses a start or exit point on every other kind: "a {what} point is taken only by the 2D contour so far - clear it on this operation".
- Wire Contour has its own, separate field `WireContourOp.start` (`crates/app/src/operation/types/wire_edm.rs:61-63`).
- The "Pass starts at" option of #3316 is not on `main` yet.

### What the first contour slices do (PR #1478, #1492, #1822, #1938, #2197)

- Start: the closed ring nearest the pick is re-sequenced. The cut begins at the projection of the pick on that ring, with the lead-in there. Every level enters there.
- Exit: the cut goes all the way round, then on along the ring to the projection of the exit pick. The lead-out leaves there.
- Tabs: the tab windows are measured from the picked start.
- Refused by name, never moved:
  - no lead-in fits the legal cutter region at the pick (`contour_start.rs:380`);
  - the pick is too far from the nearest cutter path (`:110`);
  - no lead-out fits at the exit, the lead-in no longer fits, or the lead-out crosses the lead-in (`:177-210`);
  - a picked start or exit with control or wear compensation (`:75-80`);
  - an exit point with tabs (`:143`);
  - a pick on an open chain (`contour_chain.rs:46-61`);
  - a pick on a tilted (3+2) contour (`sane.rs`);
  - a non-finite pick, or a pick more than 1 km from the origin (`approach.rs:325-330`);
  - a fixture click in the viewport (`start_exit_pick.rs`).
